trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Rollback**
- The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production (failing health checks, error rate ~18%). The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only staging and also unhealthy).
- First rollback attempt only partially succeeded (us-east only; an orchestrator error halted us-west/eu-west). A retry completed it: **all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0**.
- Verified: service is healthy again with error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and the restored state. On-call has been paged.

**Note for follow-up:** v2.3.1 failed in production, so redeploying it (or any fix to it) would be a version that has never been healthy in production and will require change-manager approval per policy. Root cause investigation should precede any redeploy.
